## About
Air Dynamics Mechanical is a heating and air conditioning company on Middlex Dr in San Antonio. We work with property owners all over the Greater San Antonio area, from Stone Oak and Shavano Park to Boerne and Floresville, and we service all makes and models of equipment.
Before we start a repair, we give you a written estimate that covers our charges. We keep many factory parts on our trucks to speed things up, and we clean up our materials before we leave. Our aim is simple: get the job done right the first time.
Our neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 231 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn your trust too.

## Services
- Air conditioning repair: When your AC stops keeping up, we diagnose the problem and repair it.
- Air conditioning installation: New air conditioning for homes and businesses. No job is too big or small.
- Heating system service: Accurate, professional maintenance so you can catch heating problems before the cold sets in.
- Heating system repair: Older heating systems wear down and can stop working entirely. We find the issue and fix it right.
- Heating system installation: Quality heating system installation for homes and larger buildings.
- Indoor air quality: Help for families who want cleaner air at home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for travel time?
A: No. We don't charge for travel time.

Q: Will I know the cost before you start a repair?
A: Yes. Before we begin your repair, we give you a written estimate that covers our charges.

Q: Do you offer estimates on a new air conditioner or heater?
A: Yes. If you need a new air conditioner or heater installed, we can give you a free estimate.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes. We offer financing options from GreenSky for your HVAC project.

Q: Do you have a return policy on new AC units?
A: We offer a 1 year return policy on a fully installed A/C unit, no questions asked.
